name: Sanguinaria canadensis extract
description: Sanguinaria canadensis extract (CAS 84929-48-6 ), also known as bloodroot extract, is a botanical-derived active obtained from the rhizome of the North American bloodroot plant. It delivers antimicrobial and antioxidant activity across personal care, pharmaceutical, and food-related formulations. Natural preservation and bioactive performance are primary sourcing drivers for this ingredient. In oral care products such as toothpastes and mouthwashes, the extract is incorporated for its antimicrobial action against plaque-forming bacteria. Cosmetic formulators use it in skin care and topical preparations where botanical preservation and antioxidant stabilization are required alongside active positioning. In pharmaceutical applications, it functions as a bioactive ingredient in formulations targeting microbial control. Food and nutrition product developers evaluate it as a natural antioxidant component in specialty formulations. This is particularly relevant where botanical-sourced stabilizers are preferred over synthetic alternatives in the production process. Sanguinaria canadensis extract is supplied as a liquid extract, dry powder, or standardized concentrate. Standardization is typically referenced against sanguinarine alkaloid content to ensure consistent potency and efficacy across different batches. Both cosmetic-grade and pharmaceutical-grade specifications are available depending on end-use regulatory requirements. Buyers should confirm solvent system, extraction ratio, and standardization level when evaluating various supplier offerings. These parameters vary significantly across the market, making technical documentation essential for procurement.
